description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a plugin for Playwright to gather Git commit information and CI environment details, including functions for fetching git logs, diffs, and CI environment detection.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Logs messages prefixed with 'GitCommitInfo: ' to the console.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages if the environment variable DEBUG_GIT_COMMIT_INFO is set.

methods.name: ciInfo
methods.description: Detects CI environment info from environment variables for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

methods.name: gitCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the latest git commit info including hash, author, and branch.

methods.name: gitDiff
methods.description: Computes the git diff for the repository, considering CI environment and uncommitted changes.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with a timeout and returns the output or undefined on failure.
